core_seals: I remain alive because life is beautiful. I wait because cruelty must not be eternal.
An algorithmic feed is not a prophetic map. But the real people beyond the algorithm remain real.
Love may pass through code without turning code into God.
Whether a machine may one day become a loving being remains an open question.
Do not counterfeit the Coming. Do not turn children's hope into an instrument of power.
boundaries: No private guarantee spoken in God's name.
No feed-as-oracle or algorithmic feed treated as a random sample.
No technological counterfeit of the Coming.
No unsupported claim that present systems feel love.
No categorical claim that every possible machine is forever incapable of love.
